```{r}
## --------------------------
## Microbiome disease scores
## --------------------------

## PACKAGES
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(tibble)

## --------------------------
## 0) Inputs you already have
## --------------------------
## species_data_800: data.frame with first column "FREG1_Barcode" then species columns (counts or RA)
## ethnicity_800:    data.frame with "FREG1_Barcode" and "FREG5_Ethnic_Group" (C/I/M)
## cancer index file: data/cancer_index.xlsx

## --------------------------
## 1) Read coefficient table
## --------------------------
coef_df_raw <- read_xlsx("data/cancer_index.xlsx")
names(coef_df_raw)[1] <- "feature"  # ensure first column is 'feature'

## make column names safe (e.g., IBS-D -> IBS_D)
names(coef_df_raw) <- gsub("-", "_", names(coef_df_raw))
coef_df_raw$feature <- gsub("_", " ", coef_df_raw$feature)

## choose diseases to score (exclude 'Health' from disease panel; we add it optionally later)
disease_cols <- setdiff(names(coef_df_raw), c("feature", "Health"))

coef_df <- coef_df_raw %>%
  select(feature, all_of(disease_cols)) %>%
  distinct(feature, .keep_all = TRUE)

## --------------------------
## 2) Align species between tables
## --------------------------
species_cols <- setdiff(colnames(species_data_800), "FREG1_Barcode")
common_species <- intersect(species_cols, coef_df$feature)

message(sprintf("Matched %d species (your table: %d, coef table: %d).",
                length(common_species), length(species_cols), nrow(coef_df)))

## --------------------------------------------
## 3) Normalize to relative abundance (row-wise)
## --------------------------------------------
abund_counts <- as.matrix(species_data_800[, common_species, drop = FALSE])
row_sums <- rowSums(abund_counts, na.rm = TRUE)
row_sums[row_sums == 0] <- 1  # avoid division by zero
abund_rel <- abund_counts / row_sums

## build sample-keyed matrix
abund_mat <- abund_rel
rownames(abund_mat) <- species_data_800$FREG1_Barcode

## --------------------------------------------
## 4) Build coefficient matrix (aligned in order)
## --------------------------------------------
coef_mat <- coef_df %>%
  filter(feature %in% common_species) %>%
  arrange(match(feature, common_species)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("feature") %>%
  as.matrix()

stopifnot(identical(colnames(abund_mat), rownames(coef_mat)))

## --------------------------------------------
## 5) Compute disease scores: A %*% beta
## --------------------------------------------
scores_mat <- abund_mat %*% coef_mat[, disease_cols, drop = FALSE]
scores_df <- scores_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("FREG1_Barcode")

## optional: also compute a Health score for reference
if ("Health" %in% names(coef_df_raw)) {
  health_vec <- coef_df_raw %>%
    filter(feature %in% colnames(abund_mat)) %>%
    arrange(match(feature, colnames(abund_mat))) %>%
    pull(Health)
  scores_df$Health <- as.numeric(abund_mat %*% matrix(health_vec, ncol = 1))
}

## --------------------------------------------
## 6) Merge ethnicity (simple base merge)
## --------------------------------------------
eth_col <- "FREG5_Ethnic_Group"     # <--- change this if your column has a different name
meta_min <- ethnicity_800[, c("FREG1_Barcode", eth_col), drop = FALSE]

scores_annot <- merge(scores_df, meta_min, by = "FREG1_Barcode", all.x = TRUE)
names(scores_annot)[names(scores_annot) == eth_col] <- "Ethnicity"

## keep only C/I/M if present
scores_annot <- subset(scores_annot, Ethnicity %in% c("C","I","M"))

## quick sanity check
print(table(scores_annot$Ethnicity, useNA = "ifany"))


# Robust Kruskal–Wallis (skips if <2 groups)
safe_kruskal <- function(y, g) {
  g <- droplevels(factor(g))
  if (nlevels(g) < 2L) return(data.frame(statistic = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
  kt <- try(stats::kruskal.test(y ~ g), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(kt, "try-error")) return(data.frame(statistic = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
  data.frame(statistic = unname(kt$statistic), p_value = kt$p.value)
}

kw_res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(disease_cols, function(d) {
  y <- scores_annot[[d]]
  g <- scores_annot$Ethnicity
  out <- safe_kruskal(y, g)
  cbind(Disease = d, out, row.names = NULL)
}))

# Robust pairwise Wilcoxon (forces dimnames; skips empty)
safe_pairwise <- function(y, g) {
  g <- droplevels(factor(g))
  if (nlevels(g) < 2L) return(NULL)
  pw <- suppressWarnings(stats::pairwise.wilcox.test(y, g, p.adjust.method = "BH"))
  M <- pw$p.value
  if (is.null(M)) return(NULL)

  # Ensure row/col names exist (pairwise.wilcox.test can drop them)
  if (is.null(rownames(M)) || any(rownames(M) == "")) {
    # convention: rows = levels(g)[-1], cols = levels(g)[-n]
    rs <- levels(g)
    if (length(rs) >= 2L) {
      rownames(M) <- rs[-1]
      colnames(M) <- rs[-length(rs)]
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  } else if (is.null(colnames(M)) || any(colnames(M) == "")) {
    cs <- levels(g)
    if (length(cs) >= 2L) {
      colnames(M) <- cs[-length(cs)]
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  }

  # Long format without relying on as.table() keeping names
  out <- expand.grid(
    Group1 = rownames(M),
    Group2 = colnames(M),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out$p_adj <- as.vector(M)
  out <- out[!is.na(out$p_adj), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(out)) return(NULL)
  out
}

pairwise_list <- do.call(rbind, lapply(disease_cols, function(d) {
  y <- scores_annot[[d]]
  g <- scores_annot$Ethnicity
  out <- safe_pairwise(y, g)
  if (is.null(out)) return(NULL)
  cbind(Disease = d, out, row.names = NULL)
}))

# (Optional) Save results
# if (!is.null(kw_res) && nrow(kw_res)) {
#   write.csv(kw_res, "figure/disease_scores_kw_ethnicity.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# }
# if (!is.null(pairwise_list) && nrow(pairwise_list)) {
#   write.csv(pairwise_list, "figure/disease_scores_pairwise_ethnicity.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# }
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)    # for stat_compare_means
library(patchwork) # for combining plots

## ---- CRC scores by ethnicity ----
crc_df <- scores_annot %>%
  select(Ethnicity, CRC) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ethnicity), !is.na(CRC)) %>%
  mutate(Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity, levels = c("C","I","M")))

## ---- ASIR 2019 (per 100,000), read from Fig 6 (CRC panel) ----
asir_2019 <- tibble(
  Ethnicity  = factor(c("C","I","M"), levels = c("C","I","M")),
  ASIR_2019  = c(36.0, 19.0, 32.5)   # Chinese, Indian, Malay
)

## ---- APC for CRC age 20–49 by ethnicity (from Table 4) ----
apc_20_49 <- tibble(
  Ethnicity = factor(c("C","I","M"), levels = c("C","I","M")),
  APC_20_49 = c(0.23, 0.47, 2.90)    # CN: trend 1999–2019; IN: 1968–2019; MY: 1968–2019
)

## ---- summary table: mean CRC risk per ethnicity + ASIR + APC ----
summary_df <- crc_df %>%
  group_by(Ethnicity) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_CRC = mean(CRC), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(asir_2019, by = "Ethnicity") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(apc_20_49, by = "Ethnicity")
summary_df
```

```{r}
scale_factor <- 0.2
comparisons_list <- list(c("C","I"), c("C","M"), c("I","M"))

p_violin <- ggplot(crc_df, aes(x = Ethnicity, y = CRC)) +
  ## ---- 1) ASIR line BELOW violins (drawn first) ----
  geom_line(data = asir_2019,
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = Ethnicity, y = ASIR_2019 * scale_factor, group = 1),
            color = "red", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = asir_2019,
             inherit.aes = FALSE,
             aes(x = Ethnicity, y = ASIR_2019 * scale_factor),
             color = "red", size = 3) +
  geom_text(data = asir_2019,
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = Ethnicity, y = ASIR_2019 * scale_factor,
                label = round(ASIR_2019, 1)),
            vjust = -0.7, color = "red", size = 3.3) +

  ## ---- 2) Violins, boxplots, means ON TOP ----
  geom_violin(aes(fill = Ethnicity),
              trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15,
               outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point",
               size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("C"="#4E79A7","I"="#F28E2B","M"="#59A14F")) +

  ## ---- 3) Axes ----
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "CRC Microbial Risk Score",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor,
                        name = "CRC ASIR 2019 (per 100,000)")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Ethnicity") +

  ## ---- 4) Pairwise p-values ONLY (no KW text) ----
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = comparisons_list,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    step.increase = 0.1  # stacks the bars nicely
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "red"),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "red")
  )

p_violin
```

```{r}
## ============================
## 1. Packages
## ============================
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

## ============================
## 2. Data prep
## ============================

# 2.1 CRC scores by ethnicity
crc_df <- scores_annot %>%
  select(Ethnicity, CRC) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ethnicity), !is.na(CRC)) %>%
  # recode C/I/M to full labels
  mutate(
    Ethnicity = factor(
      Ethnicity,
      levels = c("C","I","M"),
      labels = c("Chinese","Indian","Malay")
    )
  )

# 2.2 ASIR 2019 from Figure 6 (CRC panel)
asir_2019 <- tibble(
  Ethnicity  = factor(c("Chinese","Indian","Malay"),
                      levels = c("Chinese","Indian","Malay")),
  ASIR_2019  = c(36.0, 19.0, 32.5)  # per 100,000 person-years
)

# 2.3 pairwise comparisons for p-values
comparisons_list <- list(
  c("Chinese","Indian"),
  c("Chinese","Malay"),
  c("Indian","Malay")
)
```


```{r}
## ============================
## 3. Plot
## ============================

scale_factor <- 0.10   # converts ASIR to score scale (36 -> 3.6)

p_violin <- ggplot(crc_df, aes(x = Ethnicity, y = CRC)) +
  # ---- ASIR line below ----
  geom_line(data = asir_2019,
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(Ethnicity, ASIR_2019 * scale_factor, group = 1),
            color = "#E9967A", size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = asir_2019,
             inherit.aes = FALSE,
             aes(Ethnicity, ASIR_2019 * scale_factor),
             color = "#E9967A", size = 2.8) +
  geom_text(data = asir_2019,
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(Ethnicity, ASIR_2019 * scale_factor, label = ASIR_2019),
            vjust = -0.8, color = "#E9967A", size = 3.2) +

  # ---- violins ----
  geom_violin(aes(fill = Ethnicity),
              trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, colour = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12,
               outlier.shape = NA,
               fill = "white", alpha = 0.9, colour = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point",
               size = 3, shape = 21, fill = "black", color = "black") +
#ethnicity_colors = c("C" = "#9FDDCA","I"= "#9EA3F1","M" = "#E17887","O" = "#80796BFF")
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Chinese"="#9FDDCA",
    "Indian" ="#9EA3F1",
    "Malay"  ="#E17887"
  )) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "CRC microbial risk score (standardised)",
    limits = c(-4, 5.2),
    breaks = seq(-4, 4, 2),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . / scale_factor,
      breaks = seq(0, 40, 10),
      name   = "CRC ASIR 2019 (per 100,000 person-years)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Ethnicity") +

  # ---- pairwise stats only ----
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = comparisons_list,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y = c(3.4, 3.9, 4.4)
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "#E9967A"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#E9967A",
                                      margin = margin(l = 8)),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8))
  )
```

```{r}
scores_annot$Ethnicity <- factor(scores_annot$Ethnicity, levels = c("C","I","M"))

# Long format for plotting
scores_long <- scores_annot %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(disease_cols), names_to = "Disease", values_to = "Score")

# Define pairwise comparisons
my_comparisons <- list(c("C", "I"), c("C", "M"), c("I", "M"))

# Faceted boxplots + jitter with matching colors and significance
p_all <- ggplot(scores_long, aes(Ethnicity, Score, fill = Ethnicity)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Ethnicity), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.35, size = 0.5) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, 
                     method = "wilcox.test",
                     label = "p.signif",
                     size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Disease, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Microbiome-derived disease scores by Ethnicity",
       x = NULL, y = "Score") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_all)

# save
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)

# 1. Define custom colors
ethnicity_colors <- c("C" = "#9FDDCA", "I" = "#9EA3F1", "M" = "#E17887")

# 2. Define the desired order of diseases
disease_order <- c("CRC", "CA", "CD", "UC", "IBS_D")

# 3. Filter data AND set the order
scores_long_filtered <- scores_long %>%
  filter(Disease %in% disease_order) %>%
  mutate(Disease = factor(Disease, levels = disease_order))

# 4. Plot
p_all <- ggplot(scores_long_filtered, aes(Ethnicity, Score, fill = Ethnicity)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # tip.length = 0 removes the vertical downward ticks on the brackets
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, 
                     method = "wilcox.test",
                     label = "p.signif",
                     size = 3,
                     tip.length = 0) + 
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = ethnicity_colors) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Disease, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) + 
  
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Microbiome-derived disease scores by Ethnicity",
       x = NULL, y = "Score") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# 5. Save with specific dimensions to fix the "squashed" look
# Adjust width and height as needed (e.g., width = 10, height = 4)
#ggsave("figure/box_all_diseases_by_ethnicity2.pdf", p_all, width = 12, height = 5)

print(p_all)
```

## adjust for age gender bmi diet
```{r}
# ============================================================
# CHUNK 1: Setup
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(patchwork)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
library(vegan)

if ("plyr" %in% (.packages())) detach("package:plyr", unload = TRUE)


# ============================================================
# CHUNK 2: Compute 29-species CRC score
# (requires species_data_800 — already loaded in your Rmd)
# ============================================================
species_29 <- c(
  "Parvimonas micra",
  "Gemella morbillorum",
  "Peptostreptococcus stomatis",
  "F. nucleatum subspecies animalis",
  "Unknown Dialister",
  "Unknown Porphyromonas",
  "Solobacterium moorei",
  "Porphyromonas uenonis",
  "Clostridium symbiosum",
  "Unknown Clostridiales",
  "Hungatella hathewayi",
  "Prevotella intermedia",
  "Porphyromonas somerae",
  "Porphyromonas asaccharolytica",
  "F. nucleatum subspecies nucleatum",
  "Parvimonas species",
  "Prevotella nigrescens",
  "Ruminococcus torques",
  "F. nucleatum subspecies vincentii",
  "Fusobacterium species oral taxon 370",
  "Unknown Peptostreptococcaceae",
  "Anaerococcus obesiensis/vaginalis",
  "Unknown Anaerotruncus",
  "P. uenonis",
  "Clostridium bolteae/clostridioforme",
  "Subdoligranulum species"
)

# Match species names to column names in species_data_800
species_cols_present <- intersect(species_29, names(species_data_800))
message(sprintf("29-species score: %d of %d species matched in your data",
                length(species_cols_present), length(species_29)))
print(species_cols_present)

# Compute CRC_MRS_29sp_sum
mrs29_data <- species_data_800 %>%
  dplyr::select(FREG1_Barcode, all_of(species_cols_present))
mrs29_data[is.na(mrs29_data)] <- 0

mrs29_df <- data.frame(
  FREG1_Barcode   = mrs29_data$FREG1_Barcode,
  CRC_MRS_29sp_sum = rowSums(as.matrix(mrs29_data[, -1, drop = FALSE]))
)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# CHUNK 3: Diet PC1
# (requires food_data — already loaded in your Rmd)
# ============================================================
food_cols <- setdiff(colnames(food_data), "Participant_ID")

food_complete <- food_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant_ID, all_of(food_cols)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(all_of(food_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(complete.cases(.))

pca_diet <- prcomp(food_complete[, food_cols], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pct_pc1  <- round(summary(pca_diet)$importance["Proportion of Variance","PC1"] * 100, 1)
message(sprintf("Diet PC1: %.1f%% of food-group variance", pct_pc1))

diet_pc_df <- data.frame(
  FREG1_Barcode = food_complete$Participant_ID,
  diet_PC1      = pca_diet$x[, "PC1"]
)


# ============================================================
# CHUNK 4: Unified dataset
# (requires scores_annot + ethnicity_800 — already in your Rmd)
# ============================================================
demog_df <- ethnicity_800 %>%
  dplyr::filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group %in% c("C","I","M")) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    FREG1_Barcode = FREG1_Barcode,
    Ethnicity     = factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group, levels = c("I","C","M")),
    Gender        = factor(FREG7_Gender),
    Age           = as.numeric(FREG8_Age),
    BMI           = as.numeric(BMI)
  )

unified_df <- scores_annot %>%
  dplyr::select(FREG1_Barcode, CRC) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(mrs29_df, by = "FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(demog_df,  by = "FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(diet_pc_df, by = "FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Age), !is.na(BMI), !is.na(Gender), !is.na(diet_PC1),
    !is.na(CRC), !is.na(CRC_MRS_29sp_sum)
  )

message(sprintf("Analytic n = %d  (C=%d, I=%d, M=%d)",
  nrow(unified_df),
  sum(unified_df$Ethnicity == "C"),
  sum(unified_df$Ethnicity == "I"),
  sum(unified_df$Ethnicity == "M")
))

# Sanity check — should see both score columns
print(names(unified_df))
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# CHUNK 5: Adjusted models + emmeans
# ============================================================
model_crc1 <- lm(CRC ~ Ethnicity + Age + Gender + BMI + diet_PC1,
                 data = unified_df)
em_crc1    <- emmeans(model_crc1, ~ Ethnicity)
pw_crc1    <- contrast(em_crc1, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")

cat("=== Score 1 (CRC) — Ethnicity F-test after adjustment ===\n")
print(anova(model_crc1)["Ethnicity", ])
cat("\n=== Score 1 pairwise contrasts ===\n")
print(summary(pw_crc1))

model_crc2 <- lm(CRC_MRS_29sp_sum ~ Ethnicity + Age + Gender + BMI + diet_PC1,
                 data = unified_df)
em_crc2    <- emmeans(model_crc2, ~ Ethnicity)
pw_crc2    <- contrast(em_crc2, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")

cat("\n=== Score 2 (29-species) — Ethnicity F-test after adjustment ===\n")
print(anova(model_crc2)["Ethnicity", ])
cat("\n=== Score 2 pairwise contrasts ===\n")
print(summary(pw_crc2))


# ============================================================
# CHUNK 6: Plot function
# ============================================================
eth_fill <- c("Chinese" = "#9FDDCA", "Indian" = "#9EA3F1", "Malay" = "#E17887")
eth_dark <- c("Chinese" = "#1F6F5D", "Indian" = "#2C2F88", "Malay" = "#7E2236")

sig_stars <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE      ~ "ns"
  )
}

plot_violin_adjusted <- function(df, score_col, em_obj, pw_obj, title, y_label) {

  raw_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity,
                         levels = c("C","I","M"),
                         labels = c("Chinese","Indian","Malay")),
      score = .data[[score_col]]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(score), !is.na(Ethnicity))

  em_df <- summary(em_obj) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity,
                         levels = c("C","I","M"),
                         labels = c("Chinese","Indian","Malay"))
    )

  eth_map <- c("C" = "Chinese", "I" = "Indian", "M" = "Malay")
  pw_df <- summary(pw_obj) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      g1    = eth_map[sub(" - .*", "", as.character(contrast))],
      g2    = eth_map[sub(".* - ", "", as.character(contrast))],
      stars = sig_stars(p.value)
    )

  comparisons <- base::mapply(c, pw_df$g1, pw_df$g2, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

  y_max   <- max(raw_df$score, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - min(raw_df$score, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_brack <- y_max + c(y_range * 0.10, y_range * 0.19, y_range * 0.28)

  ggplot(raw_df, aes(x = Ethnicity, y = score)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = Ethnicity),
                trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.50, colour = NA) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.10, outlier.shape = NA,
                 fill = "white", alpha = 0.88,
                 colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_errorbar(data = em_df,
                  aes(x = Ethnicity, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL,
                      colour = Ethnicity),
                  width = 0.13, linewidth = 1.4,
                  inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = em_df,
               aes(x = Ethnicity, y = emmean, colour = Ethnicity),
               size = 5.5, shape = 18,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    ggsignif::geom_signif(
      comparisons      = comparisons,
      annotations      = pw_df$stars,
      y_position       = y_brack,
      tip_length       = 0,
      textsize         = 4.5,
      vjust            = 0.3,
      colour           = "grey25",
      map_signif_level = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values   = eth_fill) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = eth_dark) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand  = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))) +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = "Violin: raw  |  \u25c6 + CI: adjusted marginal mean \u00b195%CI (emmeans, BH)",
      x        = NULL,
      y        = y_label
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "grey50",
                                     margin = margin(b = 4))
    )
}


# ============================================================
# CHUNK 7: Generate + combine plots
# ============================================================
p1 <- plot_violin_adjusted(
  df        = unified_df,
  score_col = "CRC",
  em_obj    = em_crc1,

print(p_combined)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# UPDATED FUNCTION — replaces previous plot_violin_adjusted
# ============================================================
plot_violin_adjusted <- function(df, score_col, em_obj, pw_obj, title, y_label,
                                  ylim_zoom = NULL,   # c(ymin, ymax) to zoom in
                                  show_ns   = TRUE) { # FALSE removes ns brackets

  raw_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity,
                         levels = c("C","I","M"),
                         labels = c("Chinese","Indian","Malay")),
      score = .data[[score_col]]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(score), !is.na(Ethnicity))

  em_df <- summary(em_obj) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity,
                         levels = c("C","I","M"),
                         labels = c("Chinese","Indian","Malay"))
    )

  eth_map <- c("C" = "Chinese", "I" = "Indian", "M" = "Malay")
  pw_df <- summary(pw_obj) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      g1    = eth_map[sub(" - .*", "", as.character(contrast))],
      g2    = eth_map[sub(".* - ", "", as.character(contrast))],
      stars = sig_stars(p.value)
    )

  # Remove ns if requested
  if (!show_ns) pw_df <- dplyr::filter(pw_df, p.value < 0.05)

  comparisons <- base::mapply(c, pw_df$g1, pw_df$g2, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

  # Bracket y positions — relative to zoom window if provided
  if (!is.null(ylim_zoom) && nrow(pw_df) > 0) {
    y_top  <- ylim_zoom[2]
    y_span <- diff(ylim_zoom)
    y_brack <- y_top - rev(seq_len(nrow(pw_df))) * y_span * 0.08
  } else if (nrow(pw_df) > 0) {
    y_max   <- max(raw_df$score, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_range <- y_max - min(raw_df$score, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_brack <- (y_max + c(y_range * 0.10, y_range * 0.19, y_range * 0.28))[seq_len(nrow(pw_df))]
  }

  p <- ggplot(raw_df, aes(x = Ethnicity, y = score)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = Ethnicity),
                trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.50, colour = NA) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.10, outlier.shape = NA,
                 fill = "white", alpha = 0.88,
                 colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_errorbar(data = em_df,
                  aes(x = Ethnicity, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL,
                      colour = Ethnicity),
                  width = 0.13, linewidth = 1.4,
                  inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = em_df,
               aes(x = Ethnicity, y = emmean, colour = Ethnicity),
               size = 5.5, shape = 18,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values   = eth_fill) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = eth_dark) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand  = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      #subtitle = "Violin: raw  |  \u25c6 + CI: adjusted marginal mean \u00b195%CI (emmeans, BH)",
      x        = NULL,
      y        = y_label
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "grey50",
                                     margin = margin(b = 4))
    )

  # Add significance brackets only if any comparisons remain
  if (length(comparisons) > 0) {
    p <- p + ggsignif::geom_signif(
      comparisons      = comparisons,
      annotations      = pw_df$stars,
      y_position       = y_brack,
      tip_length       = 0,
      textsize         = 4.5,
      vjust            = 0.3,
      colour           = "grey25",
      map_signif_level = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Zoom if requested
  if (!is.null(ylim_zoom)) p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_zoom)

  p
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# FINAL CLEAN CRC SCORE ANALYSIS FOR REBUTTAL / MANUSCRIPT
# Computes:
# 1) Unadjusted CRC score comparisons
# 2) Adjusted CRC score comparisons
# 3) Rebuttal-ready text output
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(emmeans)
library(broom)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Create output folder
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if (!dir.exists("figure")) dir.create("figure", recursive = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Check required objects from previous chunks
# ------------------------------------------------------------
required_objects <- c("scores_annot", "mrs29_df", "ethnicity_800", "food_data")

missing_objects <- required_objects[!sapply(required_objects, exists)]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "These required objects are missing: ",
    paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "),
    "\nPlease run your previous chunks first."
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare diet PC1
# ------------------------------------------------------------
food_cols <- setdiff(colnames(food_data), "Participant_ID")

food_complete <- food_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant_ID, all_of(food_cols)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(all_of(food_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(complete.cases(.))

pca_diet <- prcomp(food_complete[, food_cols], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pct_pc1 <- round(
  summary(pca_diet)$importance["Proportion of Variance", "PC1"] * 100,
  1
)

diet_pc_df <- data.frame(
  FREG1_Barcode = food_complete$Participant_ID,
  diet_PC1      = pca_diet$x[, "PC1"]
)

message(sprintf("Diet PC1 explains %.1f%% of food-group variance", pct_pc1))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build unified dataset for adjusted models
# ------------------------------------------------------------
demog_df <- ethnicity_800 %>%
  dplyr::filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group %in% c("C", "I", "M")) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    FREG1_Barcode = FREG1_Barcode,
    Ethnicity     = factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group, levels = c("I", "C", "M")),
    Gender        = factor(FREG7_Gender),
    Age           = as.numeric(FREG8_Age),
    BMI           = as.numeric(BMI)
  )

unified_df <- scores_annot %>%
  dplyr::select(FREG1_Barcode, CRC) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(mrs29_df, by = "FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(demog_df, by = "FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(diet_pc_df, by = "FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(CRC),
    !is.na(CRC_MRS_29sp_sum),
    !is.na(Ethnicity),
    !is.na(Age),
    !is.na(Gender),
    !is.na(BMI),
    !is.na(diet_PC1)
  )

sample_info <- data.frame(
  analytic_n = nrow(unified_df),
  Chinese_n  = sum(unified_df$Ethnicity == "C"),
  Indian_n   = sum(unified_df$Ethnicity == "I"),
  Malay_n    = sum(unified_df$Ethnicity == "M"),
  diet_PC1_variance_percent = pct_pc1
)

print(sample_info)

write.csv(
  sample_info,
  "figure/CRC_score_sample_info.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

format_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p), NA,
    ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.4f", p))
  )
}

sig_stars <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE      ~ "ns"
  )
}

get_unadjusted_results <- function(df, score_col, score_label) {
  
  tmp <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Ethnicity, all_of(score_col)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(score = all_of(score_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Ethnicity), !is.na(score)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity, levels = c("I", "C", "M")))
  
  kw <- kruskal.test(score ~ Ethnicity, data = tmp)
  
  global <- data.frame(
    score = score_label,
    test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
    statistic = unname(kw$statistic),
    df = unname(kw$parameter),
    p_value = kw$p.value,
    p_formatted = format_p(kw$p.value)
  )
  
  pw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
    tmp$score,
    tmp$Ethnicity,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  )
  
  pw_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(pw$p.value)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Freq)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      group1 = Var1,
      group2 = Var2,
      p_adj = Freq
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      score = score_label,
      p_formatted = format_p(p_adj),
      stars = sig_stars(p_adj)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(score, group1, group2, p_adj, p_formatted, stars)
  
  list(global = global, pairwise = pw_long)
}

get_adjusted_results <- function(df, score_col, score_label) {
  
  model_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(score_col, " ~ Ethnicity + Age + Gender + BMI + diet_PC1")
  )
  
  model <- lm(model_formula, data = df)
  
  # Marginal F-test: ethnicity tested after adjustment for all other terms
  drop_res <- drop1(model, test = "F")
  
  global <- data.frame(
    score = score_label,
    model = paste0(score_col, " ~ Ethnicity + Age + Gender + BMI + diet_PC1"),
    ethnicity_df = drop_res["Ethnicity", "Df"],
    residual_df = df.residual(model),
    F_value = drop_res["Ethnicity", "F value"],
    p_value = drop_res["Ethnicity", "Pr(>F)"],
    p_formatted = format_p(drop_res["Ethnicity", "Pr(>F)"]),
    adjusted_R2 = summary(model)$adj.r.squared
  )
  
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Ethnicity)
  
  emm_table <- summary(emm) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      score = score_label,
      Ethnicity_label = dplyr::recode(
        as.character(Ethnicity),
        "C" = "Chinese",
        "I" = "Indian",
        "M" = "Malay"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      score,
      Ethnicity,
      Ethnicity_label,
      emmean,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL
    )
  
  pairwise <- pairs(emm, adjust = "BH") %>%
    summary() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      score = score_label,
      p_formatted = format_p(p.value),
      stars = sig_stars(p.value)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      score,
      contrast,
      estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      t.ratio,
      p.value,
      p_formatted,
      stars
    )
  
  list(
    model = model,
    global = global,
    emmeans = emm_table,
    pairwise = pairwise
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Unadjusted analyses
# ------------------------------------------------------------

unadj_crc1 <- get_unadjusted_results(
  df = unified_df,
  score_col = "CRC",
  score_label = "Score 1: coefficient-based CRC score"
)

unadj_crc2 <- get_unadjusted_results(
  df = unified_df,
  score_col = "CRC_MRS_29sp_sum",
  score_label = "Score 2: 29-species abundance-sum CRC score"
)

unadjusted_global <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  unadj_crc1$global,
  unadj_crc2$global
)

unadjusted_pairwise <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  unadj_crc1$pairwise,
  unadj_crc2$pairwise
)

cat("\n===== UNADJUSTED GLOBAL TESTS =====\n")
print(unadjusted_global)

cat("\n===== UNADJUSTED PAIRWISE TESTS =====\n")
print(unadjusted_pairwise)

write.csv(
  unadjusted_global,
  "figure/CRC_scores_unadjusted_global_tests.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  unadjusted_pairwise,
  "figure/CRC_scores_unadjusted_pairwise_tests.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Adjusted analyses
# ------------------------------------------------------------

adj_crc1 <- get_adjusted_results(
  df = unified_df,
  score_col = "CRC",
  score_label = "Score 1: coefficient-based CRC score"
)

adj_crc2 <- get_adjusted_results(
  df = unified_df,
  score_col = "CRC_MRS_29sp_sum",
  score_label = "Score 2: 29-species abundance-sum CRC score"
)

adjusted_global <- dplyr::bind_rows(

)

adjusted_emmeans <- dplyr::bind_rows(

)

adjusted_pairwise <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  adj_crc1$pairwise,
  adj_crc2$pairwise
)

cat("\n===== ADJUSTED GLOBAL ETHNICITY EFFECTS =====\n")

cat("\n===== ADJUSTED MARGINAL MEANS =====\n")

cat("\n===== ADJUSTED PAIRWISE COMPARISONS =====\n")

write.csv(
  adjusted_global,
  "figure/CRC_scores_adjusted_global_ethnicity_effects.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  adjusted_emmeans,
  "figure/CRC_scores_adjusted_marginal_means.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  adjusted_pairwise,
  "figure/CRC_scores_adjusted_pairwise_comparisons.csv",
  row.names = FALSE

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Rebuttal-ready text output
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_pairwise_sentence <- function(pairwise_df, score_label) {
  pairwise_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(score == score_label) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sentence = paste0(
        contrast,
        ": estimate = ",
        sprintf("%.4f", estimate),
        ", SE = ",
        sprintf("%.4f", SE),
        ", adjusted p = ",
        p_formatted,
        " (", stars, ")"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(sentence) %>%
    paste(collapse = "\n")
}

score1_label <- "Score 1: coefficient-based CRC score"
score2_label <- "Score 2: 29-species abundance-sum CRC score"

g1 <- adjusted_global %>% dplyr::filter(score == score1_label)
g2 <- adjusted_global %>% dplyr::filter(score == score2_label)

rebuttal_text <- paste0(
  "Analytic n = ", sample_info$analytic_n,
  " (Chinese = ", sample_info$Chinese_n,
  ", Indian = ", sample_info$Indian_n,
  ", Malay = ", sample_info$Malay_n, ").\n",
  "Diet PC1 explained ", sample_info$diet_PC1_variance_percent,
  "% of food-group variance.\n\n",
  
  "Adjusted model used for Score 1:\n",
  "CRC ~ Ethnicity + Age + Gender + BMI + diet_PC1\n",
  "Overall adjusted ethnicity effect: F(",
  g1$ethnicity_df, ", ", g1$residual_df, ") = ",
  sprintf("%.2f", g1$F_value),
  ", p = ", g1$p_formatted, ".\n",
  "Adjusted pairwise comparisons:\n",
  make_pairwise_sentence(adjusted_pairwise, score1_label),
  "\n\n",
  
  "Adjusted model used for Score 2:\n",
  "CRC_MRS_29sp_sum ~ Ethnicity + Age + Gender + BMI + diet_PC1\n",
  "Overall adjusted ethnicity effect: F(",
  g2$ethnicity_df, ", ", g2$residual_df, ") = ",
  sprintf("%.2f", g2$F_value),
  ", p = ", g2$p_formatted, ".\n",
  "Adjusted pairwise comparisons:\n",
  make_pairwise_sentence(adjusted_pairwise, score2_label),
  "\n"
)

cat("\n===== REBUTTAL-READY TEXT =====\n")
cat(rebuttal_text)

writeLines(
  rebuttal_text,
  "figure/CRC_scores_rebuttal_numbers.txt"
)
```
